p: Emirates Towers, Sheikh Zayed Rd, Trade Center 2 community
Branded as a "technology museum" many visitors consider it more of an expensive art exhibition. The building is outstanding though and looks particularly impressive in the dark.

Jumeirah, Emirates Towers Boulevard, Sheikh Zayed Road
Arabic, Lebanese and Middle Eastern cuisines. Outdoor seating with perfect sense of fine dining accompanied with comfortable, Arabian-style terrace. Smoking and alcohol is permitted.
